text:
maya: Quick design check for the "compare inspector" idea — compact list + an expandable inspector pane on the right. Figma frame: https://figma.redwood/inspector-v1. Want feedback on badges, lock/pin wording, and a11y.

sam: I like inspector for deep dives. Two notes: 1) separate perf badges (bolt) from status badges (shield/star). 2) show units in-line: `13 ms (p95)` not just `13ms`.

elena: Accessibility: make the inspector pane keyboard-trapable when open and expose `aria-labelledby` for the pane title. Perf badge copy in dark mode fails AA — either darken bg or use bold 13px text.

rui: Pinning: prefer "Lock version" (clearer than Pin). On lock/unlock emit `role="status" aria-live="polite"` announcements: "Locked v1.4 to Eng workspace". Also ensure lock control is focusable in the primary row, not hidden in overflow.

ana: Small UX: when inspector opens, highlight the row and announce "Inspector opened for <model name>". Also add a toggle "Show only locked versions" in filter rail.

sam: Filters: when focusing the chip list NVDA reads everything — add `aria-expanded` and collapse the long list by default. Provide a "More filters" control with proper labels.

elena: For dense keyboard users, add a table-mode switch which renders semantic `<table>` with sortable headers. Also provide a single-row action menu with `aria-haspopup` to reduce tab stops.

maya: Action items: 1) badge separation + unit tooltips (sam) 2) rename Pin->Lock + aria-live & toast undo (rui) 3) inspector pane a11y: trap focus + aria-labelledby + announcement (elena/ana) 4) filter chip collapse with aria-expanded (sam) 5) table-mode + row-level menu (elena)

design-bot: Frame 'inspector-v1' updated by maya. Labels: design-review, a11y, copy.

maya: thanks all — will update frames and post before tomorrow's crit. Drop any follow-ups here. :thumbsup:
